reviews.report:
Primary Codex /root review of frozen source e16c7dd27a8ee28433569a3a718ba86a87fa5bfa for PR992 under the existing explicit sole-owner staging authorization. This is an attributed primary agent review, not another person's approval. Deployed source a36cf4b8928abaf61faf24d48e73c5001ae25af4 admits native dashboard sessions and persists a genuine preflight NAR, but self-intake fails in the daily claim-count query before INSERT. The actual deployed error is ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE. A verified-TLS read-only transaction on the recovery clone with union_eyes_runtime and the installed postgres-js/Drizzle stack reproduced the raw Date failure and showed that column-encoded gte/lt predicates succeed with string parameters. Reproduction SHA256: 09f76e4d30d812297d56827d620e0f21859978bce3d0d65e2b7dc2abe9505df3.

The two application/test files replace only the raw count-query comparisons with Drizzle gte and lt, preserving the existing local-midnight inclusive lower bound, next-midnight exclusive upper bound and the current claim-number algorithm. Drizzle's timestamp column encoder serializes the Date values before postgres-js, whose timestamp serializer is transparent under Drizzle. No claim identity/defaults, history mapping, policy, route authority, transaction boundaries or SQL schema is changed. The regression executes real createClaim against the native-shaped PGlite fixture with a driver-boundary logger that refuses unencoded Date values; it verifies both string parameters and the day window. The previous PGlite tests accepted Date values that the deployed driver rejects. All seven claim SQL tests pass.

The three governance files bind PR992 alone to actual branch fix/ue-canonical-timestamp-query-20261023, author anungisa, merged base a36cf4b8928abaf61faf24d48e73c5001ae25af4, and the exact application/test/governance path allowlist. No inventory outputs changed because file counts are unchanged. All 198 verifier regressions pass, including primary attribution, unchanged key, actual author, sole-parent two-file evidence commit, forbidden adjacent paths and protected boundaries. An initial new regression caught an omitted PR992 trust-key check and was corrected before this frozen source; the failed log is retained separately. The pinned Ed25519 key, exact file/blob/hash coverage, paginated API verification, signature validity, evidence commit and head-race checks remain mandatory. This is a transparent staging-only sole-owner amendment; no human security-team approval is synthesized and no production control is changed.

No unresolved P0/P1 was identified in the changed query encoding or narrow gate binding. Existing broader acceptance concerns, including role authorization, claim numbering under concurrency and native end-to-end persistence, remain subject to the programme and are not certified by this review. Full required repository checks and protected final-head CI remain pending and mandatory. This review does not claim deployment, staging GO, independent human approval or production authorization. Fresh merged-source images, signed clone qualification, preservation of the actual owned preflight audit row and complete native acceptance remain required.

limitations: Primary agent source review only; no independent human/security-team approval.
Required final-head repository checks and protected CI remain mandatory.
No deployed repair, native authorization or end-to-end staging acceptance is claimed.
Fresh signed release/clone qualification and complete native acceptance remain separate requirements.
